capabilities: Convert Bible references into JW Library links
Insert links via commands and right-click menu
Configure link language and style in settings
extras: Not an official app; the README states it is not related to jw.org or any other organisation and to use at your own risk.
problem: Bible references typed as plain text in notes are not clickable and do not open in JW Library.

relations.evidence: a link that opens in JW Library in the language you choose

summary: Link generator that turns Bible references typed in several languages into clickable links opening in JW Library in a chosen language.
